The transaction on April 16 is permissible. (Note: the revised assessment on April 14 was not strictly necessary for transacting on April 16, as the prohibition expired on April 15.)

citations.quote: An investment advisor shall not enter into transactions on its own account which is contrary to its advice given to clients for a period of fifteen days from the day of such advice.
